<div class="cg-intro">
The '''Champlain Group''' is the Orion Arm's foremost independent, open source, intelligence and risk assessment organization. Operating across the whole of the Orion Arm, we provide timely reporting, in-depth analysis, and curated historical records for clients ranging from sovereign governments and interstellar corporations to freelancers and local authorities.
</div>

<div class="cg-brief-body">
<span class="cg-kicker">Latest bulletin — Acadian Expanse</span>
<div role="heading" aria-level="3" style="color:#E3C878; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:700;">Shells hit Fontclair International Starport</div>
Fascist shells, rockets and drones have heavily damaged a section of the Fontclair International Starport, currently used as a forward operating base by the Acadian Armed Forces. Authorities have confirmed there was no threat to the integrity of the complex's spacelift.

<div class="cg-brief-body">
<span class="cg-kicker">Highlighted article</span>
<div role="heading" aria-level="3" style="color:#E3C878; font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:700;">Königsberg-class Heavy Cruiser</div>
Ordered in 2277 as a counter to the Soviet ''Retivyy''-II cruiser under the Kriegsmarine's Plan 89Z fleet modernization program — before developments across the Orion Arm's navies forced the design to change throughout its development.
